title: Scavenger Rating Addon
description: A Fabric addon for the Scavenger mod that adds global speedrun leaderboards! Compete with players worldwide to get the fastest completion times.
body:
**Scavenger Rating Addon** is a Fabric mod that brings global speedrun leaderboards to the Scavenger mod!

Have you ever wanted to know who is the fastest player in the Scavenger mod? Now you can! This addon connects to a global database and tracks the fastest completion times for every single item and modifier combination. 

### 🏆 Features
- **Global Leaderboards:** Check out the top runners in any speedrunning category.
- **In-Game UI:** Easily filter runs by item or modifier directly inside Minecraft.
- **Simple anticheat:** Runs are strictly monitored. If a player uses Creative mode, Spectator mode, or executes any cheat/operator commands during their run, their time is instantly invalidated.
- **Multi-Language:** Translated into English and Russian.

### ⚙️ Requirements
- **Minecraft 1.21.11**
- **Fabric** & **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**
- **[Scavenger](https://modrinth.com/mod/scavenger-mod)**

> **Note:** A NeoForge version is coming soon!

### 🐛 Issues & Support
If you find a bug or have a suggestion, please report it on our [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/ketchandmayo/scav-rating/issues) page.

---
*Note: This mod requires an active internet connection to submit and fetch leaderboard scores.*
